svg.aria-label: How to make a Caipirinha, step by step: Limes and sugar. Cut half a lime into wedges, and drop them into a rocks glass with the sugar. Muddle. Press the limes firmly into the sugar, to squeeze out the juice and the oils from the peel. Don't pulverize them. Ice and cachaça. Fill the glass with crushed ice, and pour in the cachaça. Stir. Give it a good stir, bottom to top, so the sugar dissolves. Garnish. A lime wedge, if you like. Cheers!
